# Checkbox

One or many independent on or off choices, usually sent with a form.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Brand expressive</span></p>

## When to use it

**In Brand expressive:** An optional extra in the sign-up form, such as a launch reminder. Not as a second action beside sign-up.

- **Use it when:** Agreeing, picking many, optional extras; the choice waits for the form.
- **Not when:** Exactly one of a short set (radio group), or a setting that applies at once (switch).

Instead:

- [Radio group](./radio-group.md): One choice only.
- [Switch](./switch.md): Applies at once.
- [Select](./select.md): Many options in a compact list.

## Words

- Headlines are short and bold. Three to six words.
- Verbs that move: Join, Try, Go.
- Playful in headlines, plain in errors.
- Use: Join, Drop, Go, Love. Avoid: Synergy, Leverage, Kindly.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Go
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Explore the drop

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Space checks and unchecks. | undefined |

Test before you ship:

- [ ] Each checkbox has a visible label that is part of the hit area. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add checkbox
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Component keys

The CSS variable is the key with `/` replaced by `-` and the base `@` dropped. Each key points to a token; values live only on primitives.

| Key | What it controls | Points to, light | Points to, dark |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `control/checked` | Fill of a checked checkbox or an on switch. | `color.action.primary.@` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.action.primary.@` → `color.pink.light.600` | `color.action.primary.@` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.action.primary.@` → `color.pink.dark.600` |
| `control/track` | Track of an off switch. | `color.border.strong` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.border.strong` → `color.neutral.500` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.neutral.500` → `color.taupe.light.500` | `color.border.strong` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.border.strong` → `color.neutral.400` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.neutral.400` → `color.taupe.dark.400` |
| `control/thumb` | Switch thumb and checkmark color. | `color.surface.default` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.surface.default` → `color.neutral.0` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.neutral.0` → `color.taupe.light.0` | `color.surface.default` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.surface.default` → `color.neutral.50` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.neutral.50` → `color.taupe.dark.50` |
| `control/radius` | Checkbox corner radius. | `radius.badge` → `brand-expressive.theme.base.radius.badge` → `radius.999` | same |
